instruction: PFV means Priority Flood Volume and priority depth/PFV are soft diagnostics/secondary preferences, never hard MPC admission constraints. For the v0.6.7 methodology testbed, pumps/orifices remain continuously controllable on [0,1] and the engineering smoothing assumption is max_setting_delta_per_update=0.5 on the 10-min supervisory grid; the INP also gives orifices a 10-min full-travel time. Formal main runs keep exact_global_peak=false; exact peak is replayed afterward. The candidate production cadence is 300 s observation/model + 600 s control, but prediction horizon and remaining development parameters must still be frozen from fresh Phase0 evidence and runtime benchmarking.

objective.priority_role: soft lexicographic secondary preference within TFV near-optimal set
